Canvas.SwitchLayerOcclusion.en:
Depth order · Click for layer order
Preview and picking only, for this run. Does not modify the project.

Canvas.SwitchDepthOcclusion.zh:
图层顺序遮挡 · 点击切换深度优先
仅影响本次运行的预览与选择，不修改工程。
Canvas.SwitchDepthOcclusion.en:
Layer order · Click for depth order
Preview and picking only, for this run. Does not modify the project.

Canvas.GridCalibrationEffectShort.zh: 应用会调整比例、格距和原点，可撤销。
Canvas.GridCalibrationEffectShort.en: Applies aspect, spacing and origin changes. Undo is available.

Canvas.GridCalibrationHelp.zh:
取样框应沿实际格线，填写框内横向、纵向的方格数；格子按正方形解释。

勾选“外框四边对齐格线”：由局部格数估计整框格数，取整数以保持四边贴线。可加减、直接输入，或恢复自动估计。边界吻合不代表全图精确，请检查中间与远处的清晰格线。

不勾选：按局部取样确定格距和原点，不要求外框贴线。取样偏差使用画布坐标像素，不代表图像匹配精度。

“调整取样框”保留已填参数，返回画布微调或重画。应用会改变逻辑比例、格距和原点，已有内容的显示可能变化，但逻辑坐标不变；一次撤销可完整恢复。取消不修改画布。检查中或不安全时不显示候选；应用被拒绝时保留参数。
Canvas.GridCalibrationHelp.en:
Align the sample rectangle to actual grid lines and enter its horizontal and vertical cell counts. Cells are interpreted as squares.

With “Frame edges follow grid lines”, local counts estimate integer frame counts that keep all four edges aligned. Adjust the counts or restore the automatic estimate. Aligned boundaries do not guarantee overall accuracy; compare clear lines in the middle and distance.

Without it, the sample determines spacing and origin without constraining the frame edges. Sample deviation is in canvas-coordinate pixels, not image matching accuracy.

“Adjust sample” retains your values while you refine or redraw the rectangle. Applying changes the logical aspect, spacing and origin. Existing content may look different, but its logical coordinates are preserved. One Undo restores everything; Cancel leaves the canvas unchanged. Candidates are hidden while checking or unsafe; rejected application retains your inputs.

Canvas.PlaneSizeHelp.zh: 宽高使用逻辑像素，决定关闭透视后的比例和尺寸。纸张选项只设置比例，并保留较长边；网格大小与原点可单独调整。钉点只锚定后续的尺寸调整。
Canvas.PlaneSizeHelp.en: Logical-pixel dimensions determine the size and aspect ratio with perspective off. Paper options set only the ratio and preserve the longer edge. Grid size and origin are independent. The pin anchors subsequent size changes.

Canvas.InvalidPlaneSize.zh: 请输入有效的平面宽高。

Canvas.GridCoverage.zh: 四点框覆盖 {0:0.###} 列 × {1:0.###} 行。调整网格不改变透视或图层。
Canvas.GridCoverage.en: The frame spans {0:0.###} columns × {1:0.###} rows. Grid edits leave perspective and layers unchanged.

Canvas.RectificationHelp.zh: 本次临时截图用于比较原图与扭正结果。可选择纸张比例或输入逻辑像素宽高。四角不能单独确定物体的真实比例。应用后，关闭透视即可查看展开的截图；预览图不会作为正式截图保存。
Canvas.RectificationHelp.en: Compare this temporary capture with its rectified result. Choose a paper ratio or enter logical-pixel dimensions. Four corners alone do not establish the object's true ratio. After inserting, turn perspective off to see the unfolded capture. The preview bitmap is never saved as the original capture.

Canvas.GridCalibration.en: Calibrate from a local grid rectangle

Canvas.PickGridCountsHint.zh: 单击确定 · 超过9格可直接输入
Canvas.PickGridCountsHint.en: Click to choose. Type counts above 9.

Canvas.GridCountChoice.zh: 横向 {0} 格 × 纵向 {1} 格

Canvas.GridCountPickerHelp.zh:
点击取样格数中间的网格按钮，在9×9选择器中一次选定横纵格数。悬停只高亮，单击才更新候选；Esc或点外部关闭选择器，不修改格数。超过9格仍可直接输入。

整框数值框右侧的上、下箭头分别加一、减一；中间的恢复按钮同时清除横纵手动值，恢复自动估计。
Canvas.GridCountPickerHelp.en:
Use the grid button between the sample fields to pick both counts in a 9×9 picker. Hovering only highlights; clicking updates the candidate. Escape or an outside click dismisses the picker without changing counts. Counts above 9 can still be typed.

The up and down arrows inside each frame field change its value by one. The middle reset button clears both manual counts and restores the automatic estimate.

Canvas.GridCalibrationSpans.zh: 填写取样框内横向、纵向的方格数。取样框须沿实际格线；格子按正方形解释。
Canvas.GridCalibrationSpans.en: Enter the horizontal and vertical cell counts inside the sample rectangle. Align it to actual grid lines; cells are interpreted as squares.

Canvas.GridCalibrationResult.zh: 拟合宽高比 {0:0.#####}；格长 {1:0.###} 逻辑像素。请对照画布上的预览确认。
Canvas.GridCalibrationResult.en: Fitted aspect: {0:0.#####}; cell size: {1:0.###} logical pixels. Check the grid preview on the canvas.

Canvas.GridCalibrationEffect.zh: 应用会调整画布逻辑比例、格距和原点，已有内容的显示可能变化。可一步撤销；取消不修改画布。检查中或不安全时不显示候选；应用被拒绝时保留参数。
Canvas.GridCalibrationEffect.en: Applying changes the logical aspect, spacing and grid origin; existing content may look different. Undo restores everything in one step. Cancel leaves the canvas unchanged. Candidates are hidden while checking or unsafe; rejected application retains your inputs.

Canvas.AlignGridBoundary.zh: 透视外框的四条边已对齐格线
Canvas.AlignGridBoundary.en: All four perspective frame edges follow grid lines

Canvas.GridCandidateHelp.zh: 边界吻合不等于整体正确。请对照中间与远处的清晰格线，必要时调整整框整数格数。
Canvas.GridCandidateHelp.en: Aligned boundaries do not prove accuracy. Compare clear grid lines in the middle and farther away; adjust the integer frame counts if needed.

Canvas.GridDeviation.zh: 局部取样与候选网格偏差约 {0:0.##} 画布坐标像素；这不是图像匹配精度。
Canvas.GridDeviation.en: Sample deviation from the candidate lattice: about {0:0.##} canvas-coordinate pixels; this is not image matching accuracy.

Canvas.SampleDragHint.zh: 沿实际格线拖出局部透视矩形；只数这小块的格子。Esc / 右键取消。
Canvas.SampleDragHint.en: Drag a local perspective rectangle along grid lines. Count only these cells. Esc / right-click cancels.

Canvas.SampleAdjustHint.zh: 拖动角点微调，或在其他位置重新框选。Enter 确认；Esc / 右键恢复原取样。
Canvas.SampleAdjustHint.en: Drag a corner to adjust, or drag elsewhere to redraw. Enter confirms; Esc / right-click restores the previous sample.

Canvas.SampleTooSmall.zh: 取样框的横向或纵向跨度太小，请放大视图或跨更多格子重新框选。
Canvas.SampleTooSmall.en: The sample is too narrow or short. Zoom in or select a span across more cells.

Canvas.FlatGridOriginHelp.zh: 调整网格位置，不移动图层或文档原点。对齐钉点将网格交点放到当前钉点。钉点默认位于主屏中心，随视图平移和缩放。
Canvas.FlatGridOriginHelp.en: Moves the grid without moving layers or the document origin. Align to pin places a grid intersection at the current pin. The pin starts at the primary screen center and follows view pan and zoom.

Canvas.FourLinesHint.zh: 沿两条横向和两条纵向格线分别拖出可见片段，无需找到四个角。
Canvas.FourLinesHint.en: Trace visible portions of two horizontal and two vertical grid lines; the corners need not be visible.

Canvas.LineStep.zh: 拖出{0}的清晰片段；线段尽量长。Backspace 撤回；Esc / 右键取消。
Canvas.LineStep.en: Trace a clear, long segment of {0}. Backspace removes the last segment; Esc / right-click cancels.

Canvas.LineReview.zh: 拖动端点检查四边形。Enter 确认；Backspace 撤回；Esc / 右键取消。
Canvas.LineReview.en: Adjust endpoints and inspect the frame. Enter confirms; Backspace removes the last segment; Esc / right-click cancels.

Canvas.LineFit.MissingLines.zh: 请先完成两条横向、两条纵向参考线。
Canvas.LineFit.MissingLines.en: Complete two horizontal and two vertical reference lines first.

Canvas.LineFit.ShortLine.zh: 参考线段太短，请拖动端点拉长到至少 8 DIP。
Canvas.LineFit.ShortLine.en: A reference segment is too short. Extend it to at least 8 DIP.

Canvas.LineFit.IndistinctDirections.zh: 横向与纵向参考线方向过于接近，无法确定交点。请调整对应线段。
Canvas.LineFit.IndistinctDirections.en: The horizontal and vertical directions are too similar to intersect reliably. Adjust the reference segments.

Canvas.LineFit.InvalidQuadrilateral.zh: 参考线重合、交叉关系不正确或透视不安全，请调整线段。
Canvas.LineFit.InvalidQuadrilateral.en: The reference lines overlap, cross inconsistently, or produce an unsafe projection. Adjust the segments.

Canvas.GridFit.InvalidProjection.zh: 当前透视无法反算取样，请重新建立透视框。
Canvas.GridFit.InvalidProjection.en: The current projection cannot resolve the sample. Rebuild the frame.

Canvas.GridFit.InvalidSample.zh: 取样区域无效，请返回画布调整取样框。
Canvas.GridFit.InvalidSample.en: Invalid sample. Return to the canvas to adjust it.

Canvas.GridFit.InvalidCounts.zh: 请填写 1～256 的整数格数。
Canvas.GridFit.InvalidCounts.en: Enter whole cell counts from 1 to 256.

Canvas.GridFit.CountOutOfRange.zh: 整框候选格数超出 1～256。请检查取样格数或调整透视框范围；不会自动截断。
Canvas.GridFit.CountOutOfRange.en: Frame counts must be from 1 to 256. Check the sample counts or resize the reference frame; estimates are not silently clamped.

Canvas.GridFit.UnsafeResult.zh: 结果超出画布尺寸或格距的安全范围，请调整取样或格数。
Canvas.GridFit.UnsafeResult.en: The result exceeds safe plane size or spacing limits. Adjust the sample or counts.
